body: Quick pass: merges cleanly with main; body complete; no snapshot PNG touched. The author's quick gate failed once on one UI test (the message now shows before and after Place); after the fix the full `camcraft-ui` lib suite (536), the vise suites and clippy on app and ui were re-run green on 08a6b783, and the app code is unchanged since the gate's green app suites - the full quick gate was not re-run. Flagged ready; the reviewer rebuilds.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 08a6b783ddb12a12635a909d8043450f5598dd32 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**What looks good**
- Placement is unchanged: `builtin_vise.rs`, `mod_vise.rs` and `accessory.rs` still call the same `vise::fit_to_stock` / `modvise::fit_pair` / `accessory::fit_parallels` with the same inputs; the only change is the error type and text. `vise_fit::fit` and the dialog's `vise_fit::preview` share that one call, so preview and command cannot drift.
- No existing vise, mod vise, parallels or mcp test was edited; only `vise_needs_stock.rs` is new.
- `CommandError::Needs` displays without the prefix. The MCP `cmd_err` helpers use `to_string()`, so an MCP client still gets an error. The one other `match` (`setup_align.rs:117`) only sees `Invalid`, and none of the three Needs paths reaches it.
- Dialog with no stock: Fit is greyed with a reason, the position rows show, and Place places by position. "Open the Stock page" reuses the browser Stock-row path.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in product code (the hits are all in test files). New files are 95 and 178 lines; the edited `state_vise.rs` is 180. No snapshot PNG, no process files touched, decision file present, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1105`.

**Local results (trial merge of origin/main: already up to date, no conflicts)**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app --test vise_needs_stock` | 3 passed |
| `builtin_accessory` / `builtin_vise` / `mod_vise` / `mod_vise_plate` | 3 / 9 / 5 / 6 passed |
| `self_centering_vise` / `self_centering_vise_tilted` | 5 / 3 passed |
| `mcp_vise` / `mcp_mod_vise` / `mcp_self_centering_vise` / `mcp_accessory` | 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 passed |
| `accessory_collisions` / `mcp` | 2 / 13 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 536 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Removed test `a_refused_vise_is_named_in_the_dialog`: its "no stock" dialog text is still pinned by the queued-command test at the end of `fixture_vise_stock_tests.rs` (`InsertBuiltinVise` with `fit_stock: true` and no stock, asserting "has no stock yet", "Stock page" and no "invalid parameters"). The Place button no longer reaches that refusal, because it now places by position; the PR body and decision file say so. Fine, but say it in the PR body too.
2. With no stock, Place uses the position rows (default 0,0,0). The notice says "or place the vise by position below", but Place itself gives no reminder. A user who presses Place without editing the position gets the vise at the origin. Consider a line near Place, e.g. "Places at X/Y/Z below".
3. Stock is wider than the clamping range: the same sentence is shown before Place (preview) and after a refused Place (the error). It reads as reinforcement, not a bug.
4. "Open the Stock page" pushes `ActivateSetup` (undoable, via `browser_pane::focus`) when the dialog's setup is not the active one, then targets the Stock page. That matches the browser's own Stock row, so I consider it acceptable. Ctrl+Z reverts the activation.
5. The UI passes `state.world` to the app helpers (`vise_fit::preview`, `browser_tree`'s `stock_world_aabb_for`). That is the app-helper seam, not a Flecs call from the UI, so layering holds.

**Not exercised:** the ignored UI snapshot lane (by law), the full quick gate, other crates' suites (motion, post, sim, geometry are untouched), and a manual click-through of the dialog.
